apply-pkcs7-detached-digital-signature.title: Apply Detached PKCS#7 Signature to PDF
apply-pkcs7-detached-digital-signature.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a stream, adding an invisible signature field, and applying a PKCS#7 detached digital signature using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Certificate and Timestamp
batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and apply a visible digital signature using a PFX certificate, including timestamp authority integration, saving the signed PDFs to an output directory.

encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password and Disable Printing
encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.description: Loads a PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with a user password, disables printing by setting permissions, and saves the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-high-res-prin.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password and Print Permissions
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-high-res-prin.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set an owner password, allow high‑resolution printing, and restrict copying.

decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF with the owner password, decrypt the document, and save it as an unprotected PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-visible-digital-signature-second-pag.title: Add Visible Digital Signature to Bottom‑Right of PDF Page 2
add-visible-digital-signature-second-pag.description: Demonstrates how to place a visible digital signature field in the bottom‑right corner of the second page of a PDF, configure its appearance, and sign it using a PKCS#7 certificate with Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

add-invisible-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Add Invisible Digital Signature to PDF
add-invisible-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create an invisible signature field, apply a PKCS#7 digital signature, and save the PDF without altering its layout.

extract-signature-field-metadata.title: Extract Signature Field Metadata from PDF
extract-signature-field-metadata.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate signature form fields, and read their metadata such as signer name, reason, location, date and validation status.

extract-images-from-signed-pdf.title: Extract Images from Signed PDF to PNG
extract-images-from-signed-pdf.description: Shows how to open a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over each page's image resources, and save every embedded image as a PNG file.

remove-digital-signature-from-pdf.title: Remove Digital Signature Fields from PDF
remove-digital-signature-from-pdf.description: Shows how to programmatically delete signature fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf when the document's permissions allow it.

sign-pdf-with-smart-card.title: Sign PDF with Smart Card Certificate using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-smart-card.description: Demonstrates how to locate a smart‑card certificate, add a signature field, and apply an external signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, prompting the user for PIN entry.

sign-pdf-with-smart-card-no-pin.title: Sign PDF with Smart Card Certificate (No PIN Prompt)
sign-pdf-with-smart-card-no-pin.description: Shows how to locate a smart‑card certificate in the CurrentUser store, create a visible signature field, and sign a PDF using Aspose.Pdf without prompting the user for a PIN.

custom-security-handler-logging-pdf-acce.title: Log Access Attempts for Encrypted PDF
custom-security-handler-logging-pdf-acce.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF with user and owner passwords, then opening it while logging each access attempt and handling invalid passwords.

restrict-copy-paste-in-pdf.title: Restrict Copy‑Paste in PDF with AES‑256 Encryption
restrict-copy-paste-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to apply a security handler that disables copy‑paste by encrypting a PDF with AES‑256 and setting specific permissions.

sign-pdf-with-timestamp.title: Sign PDF with Timestamp from a TSA
sign-pdf-with-timestamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF and apply a trusted timestamp from a Time‑Stamp Authority using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-digital-signature.title: Validate Detached PKCS#7 Signature and Certificate Chain for a PDF
validate-pdf-digital-signature.description: Shows how to verify a detached PKCS#7 signature on a PDF file and examine the signer's certificate chain using .NET cryptography classes.

validate-pdf-signature-crl.title: Validate PDF Signature Revocation Using CRL Distribution Points
validate-pdf-signature-crl.description: Demonstrates how to extract a signing certificate from a PDF signature field and verify its revocation status by building a certificate chain with online CRL checking using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-signature-signing-time-utc.title: Extract Signing Time from PDF Signature and Convert to UTC
extract-pdf-signature-signing-time-utc.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieve signature fields, extract the signing time from the signature dictionary using reflection, parse the PDF date format, and convert the timestamp to UTC.

extract-certificate-chain-from-pdf-signa.title: Extract Certificate Chain from PDF Signature and Save as DER Files
extract-certificate-chain-from-pdf-signa.description: Loads a signed PDF, locates the first signature field, extracts the signing certificate, builds its X509 chain, and writes each certificate in the chain to separate DER files.

sign-pdf-with-reason-contact-location.title: Sign PDF with Reason, Contact Info, and Location
sign-pdf-with-reason-contact-location.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible signature field to a PDF and sign it using a PKCS#7 certificate while populating the Reason, ContactInfo, and Location properties.

sign-pdf-with-custom-image-appearance.title: Sign PDF with Visible Image Signature
sign-pdf-with-custom-image-appearance.description: Shows how to add a visible signature field to a PDF and sign it using a PFX certificate while using a custom PNG image as the signature appearance.

sign-pdf-lock-specific-form-fields.title: Sign PDF and Lock Form Fields with Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-lock-specific-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a digital signature field, applying a PKCS#7 signature, and setting specific form fields to read‑only to prevent further edits.

sign-pdf-and-lock-readonly.title: Sign PDF and Lock It for Read‑Only Access
sign-pdf-and-lock-readonly.description: The example encrypts a PDF to disable editing permissions, then adds a digital signature, producing a signed PDF that is read‑only.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-user-owner-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Set User/Owner Passwords
encrypt-pdf-aes256-user-owner-passwords.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, applying AES‑256 encryption, setting user and owner passwords, and saving the protected file.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-bit-restrict-editing.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128‑bit and Restrict Editing
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-bit-restrict-editing.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying RC4 128‑bit encryption with user and owner passwords, setting permissions to allow printing and content extraction while disabling modifications, and saving the encrypted file.

decrypt-pdf-extract-embedded-images.title: Decrypt PDF and Extract Embedded Images
decrypt-pdf-extract-embedded-images.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF with a user password, decrypts it, iterates through each page, and saves all embedded images to disk, determining the correct file extension from the image header.

decrypt-pdf-update-metadata.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password and Update Metadata
decrypt-pdf-update-metadata.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF using the owner password, removing its encryption, modifying document metadata (title, author, subject, keywords), and saving the updated file.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-by-filename.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Passwords Derived from File Names
batch-encrypt-pdfs-by-filename.description: Shows how to loop through a folder of PDFs, generate a password from each file name, encrypt each document using AES‑256, and save the encrypted files.

batch-decrypt-pdfs-lookup-table.title: Batch Decrypt Password-Protected PDFs Using a Lookup Table
batch-decrypt-pdfs-lookup-table.description: Demonstrates iterating over a folder of encrypted PDFs, trying a list of possible passwords, decrypting each with Aspose.Pdf, and saving the unprotected files.

batch-sign-pdfs-title-based-certificate-.title: Batch Sign PDFs Using Metadata-Driven Certificates
batch-sign-pdfs-title-based-certificate-.description: Shows how to process a folder of PDFs, select a PFX certificate based on each document's title metadata, add a visible signature field, and apply a PKCS#7 digital signature with Aspose.Pdf.

batch-encrypt-and-sign-pdfs.title: Batch Encrypt and Digitally Sign PDFs
batch-encrypt-and-sign-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files with AES‑256 and then apply a PKCS#7 digital signature to each encrypted document in a batch process.

extract-signature-field-names-and-page-n.title: Extract Signature Field Names and Page Numbers from PDF
extract-signature-field-names-and-page-n.description: The example loads a PDF, checks for form fields, and lists each signature field's name together with the page number on which it appears.

retrieve-reason-location-from-pdf-signat.title: Retrieve Reason and Location from PDF Digital Signatures
retrieve-reason-location-from-pdf-signat.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate signature fields, and read the Reason and Location metadata of each digital signature.

sign-pdf-add-custom-xmp-metadata.title: Sign PDF and Embed Custom XMP Metadata
sign-pdf-add-custom-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding custom XMP metadata, creating a digital signature field, signing the document with a PKCS#7 certificate, and saving the signed PDF.

sign-pdf-with-incremental-updates.title: Sign PDF with a Visible Signature Field for Future Signatures
sign-pdf-with-incremental-updates.description: Demonstrates adding a signature field to a PDF, applying a PKCS#7 digital signature using a PFX certificate, and saving the document so additional signatures can be added later.

encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Print-Only Permission
encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set user and owner passwords, and restrict permissions to printing only with AES‑256 encryption.

encrypt-pdf-allow-copy-block-print.title: Encrypt PDF and Allow Copying While Blocking Printing
encrypt-pdf-allow-copy-block-print.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256, set permissions to allow content extraction (copy) and prevent printing, and save the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-with-print-copy-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with Printing and Copying Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-print-copy-permissions.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and set permissions to allow printing and content extraction using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-disable-content-extraction.title: Encrypt PDF and Disable All Permissions
encrypt-pdf-disable-content-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, encrypt it with AES‑256, and set permissions to block all content extraction and other actions.

decrypt-pdf-extract-images-reencrypt.title: Decrypt PDF, Extract Images, and Re‑encrypt with New Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-extract-images-reencrypt.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF using a user password, decrypts it, extracts all embedded images to a folder, and then re‑encrypts the document with a new owner password while preserving the original user password.

encrypt-pdf-with-password-aes256.title: Encrypt PDF with Passwords (AES-256)
encrypt-pdf-with-password-aes256.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, applies AES-256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and returns the encrypted PDF bytes.

sign-pdf-with-windows-certificate.title: Sign PDF with Windows Certificate Store using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-windows-certificate.description: Demonstrates loading a certificate from the current user's store by thumbprint, creating an invisible signature field, and applying a PKCS#7 signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-certificate.title: Sign PDF with PKCS7 using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-certificate.description: Shows how to load a certificate (as a placeholder for Azure Key Vault), create a visible signature field, configure PKCS#7 signature details, and apply a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-hardware-token-pkcs11.title: Sign PDF with PKCS#7 Certificate using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-hardware-token-pkcs11.description: Loads a PDF, adds a visible signature field, configures a PKCS#7 signature with a certificate (placeholder for a hardware token), and saves the signed document.

validate-pdf-signature.title: Validate PDF Signature Using a Custom Trusted Root CA
validate-pdf-signature.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate signature fields, extract the signing certificate, and validate the certificate chain against a supplied trusted root CA using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-signature-timestamp.title: Validate PDF Signature and Verify Timestamp Within Certificate Validity
validate-pdf-signature-timestamp.description: Loads a signed PDF, verifies each digital signature, extracts the signing certificate, and checks that the signing timestamp falls inside the certificate's validity period.

extract-signature-image-to-png.title: Extract Signature Image from PDF Signature Field
extract-signature-image-to-png.description: Loads a signed PDF, retrieves the normal appearance XForm of the first signature field, renders it to a temporary one‑page PDF, and saves the rendered image as a PNG file.

extract-signature-images.title: Extract Signature Appearance Images from a PDF
extract-signature-images.description: Loads a signed PDF, locates all signature fields, extracts the visual appearance image of each signature, determines its file type, and saves the images to disk.

extract-images-from-signed-pdf__v2.title: Extract Images from Signed PDF into Page‑Specific Folders
extract-images-from-signed-pdf__v2.description: Loads a signed PDF, iterates through each page, extracts all embedded images, and saves them into separate folders named for each page.

extract-signature-certificate-chain.title: Extract Signature Certificate Chain and Verify Expiration
extract-signature-certificate-chain.description: Loads a PDF, finds signature fields, extracts the signing certificate, builds its X509 chain, and reports each certificate's validity period and expiration status.

custom-security-handler-warning-overlay.title: Secure PDF with Copy‑Paste Disabled and Warning Overlay
custom-security-handler-warning-overlay.description: Loads a PDF, adds a semi‑transparent warning stamp to every page, and applies AES‑256 encryption that disables content extraction (copy‑paste) while allowing printing.

sign-pdf-flatten-signature.title: Sign PDF and Flatten Signature Appearance
sign-pdf-flatten-signature.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF, apply a PKCS#7 certificate, and flatten the signature appearance so it cannot be edited.

sign-pdf-remove-annotations.title: Sign PDF and Remove All Annotations While Preserving the Signature
sign-pdf-remove-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then delete every page annotation without affecting the signature field, finally saving the cleaned document.

encrypt-pdf-with-password.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords
encrypt-pdf-with-password.description: Loads a PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption requiring a user password to open and an owner password to modify permissions, then saves the protected file.

encrypt-pdf-view-only-edit-password.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password for Editing Only
encrypt-pdf-view-only-edit-password.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so it can be viewed without a password while requiring an owner password for any editing, with specific permissions set.

decrypt-pdf-sign-fields-multiple-certs.title: Decrypt PDF and Re‑sign All Signature Fields with Different Certificates
decrypt-pdf-sign-fields-multiple-certs.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF, extracts every signature field, and re‑signs each field using a different PFX certificate before saving the updated document.

batch-sign-and-compress-pdfs.title: Batch Sign and Compress PDFs
batch-sign-and-compress-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF files, add a digital signature field, sign it with a PKCS#7 certificate, and compress the signed documents using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-archive-zip.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs and Create ZIP Archive
batch-encrypt-pdfs-archive-zip.description: Shows how to encrypt multiple PDF files with unique passwords using Aspose.Pdf and bundle the encrypted PDFs and a password list into a ZIP file.

extract-digest-algorithm-from-pdf-signat.title: Extract Digest Algorithm from PDF Digital Signatures
extract-digest-algorithm-from-pdf-signat.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate signature fields, and retrieve the digest hash algorithm used for timestamping.

sign-pdf-with-sha384-digest.title: Create PDF Signature with SHA‑384 Digest
sign-pdf-with-sha384-digest.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible PKCS#7 signature field to a PDF and configure the signature to use the SHA‑384 digest algorithm via Aspose.Pdf's TimestampSettings.

sign-pdf-with-sha512.title: Sign PDF with SHA‑512 Digest Using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-sha512.description: Demonstrates how to create a digital signature on a PDF document using a PKCS#7 certificate and configure the SHA‑512 digest algorithm via timestamp settings.

sign-pdf-with-4096-rsa-certificate.title: Sign PDF with RSA 4096‑bit Private Key
sign-pdf-with-4096-rsa-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using an RSA 4096‑bit certificate (PKCS#12) with Aspose.Pdf, creating a visible signature field and saving the signed document.

sign-pdf-with-ecc-p256.title: Sign PDF with ECC P‑256 Certificate
sign-pdf-with-ecc-p256.description: Demonstrates how to apply a PKCS#7 digital signature to a PDF using an ECC P‑256 certificate with Aspose.Pdf, writing the signed document back to a stream.

encrypt-pdf-with-smart-card-certificate.title: Encrypt PDF with Smart Card Certificate
encrypt-pdf-with-smart-card-certificate.description: Demonstrates loading a certificate from a smart card (HSM) and encrypting a PDF with that certificate, applying specific permissions and saving the protected file.

decrypt-pdf-with-certificate-token.title: Decrypt PDF Encrypted with Certificate Using Hardware Token
decrypt-pdf-with-certificate-token.description: Shows how to locate a certificate on a hardware token, create certificate‑based encryption options, open an encrypted PDF with Aspose.Pdf, and save it unencrypted.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate-per-doc.title: Batch Sign PDFs Using Document-Type Certificates
batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate-per-doc.description: Demonstrates how to sign multiple PDF files in a folder, selecting a certificate based on the document's metadata (title) and adding a visible signature field to each PDF.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-date-password.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Date‑Based Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-date-password.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files in a folder, generating a password from the file name and current date, and encrypting each PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-new-empty-signature-field.title: Extract Signature Fields and Add a New Empty Signature Field
add-new-empty-signature-field.description: The example opens a PDF, enumerates all existing signature fields, creates a new empty signature field on a specified page for future signing, and saves the modified document.

validate-pdf-signature-extract-san.title: Validate PDF Signature and Extract SAN from Signing Certificate
validate-pdf-signature-extract-san.description: Loads a signed PDF, verifies its digital signature, extracts the signer's X.509 certificate, and displays the Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords-re.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords then Remove User Password
encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords-re.description: The example demonstrates encrypting a PDF with both user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf, then re‑encrypting it with an empty user password to remove the user password while preserving encryption.

sign-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.title: Sign PDF and Flatten Form Fields
sign-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to apply a PKCS#7 digital signature to a PDF, add a signature field, and then flatten the document so all form fields become non‑editable.

sign-pdf-first-page-with-digital-signatu.title: Sign PDF with Visible Signature from Memory Stream
sign-pdf-first-page-with-digital-signatu.description: Loads a PDF from an expandable memory stream, creates a visible signature field on the first page, configures a PKCS#7 signature, and writes the signed PDF back to disk.

disable-content-extraction-form-filling.title: Set PDF Privileges to Disable Extraction and Form Filling
disable-content-extraction-form-filling.description: Demonstrates how to apply document privileges to a signed PDF, disabling content extraction and form filling while allowing printing, using AES‑256 encryption.

validate-pdf-digital-signature__v2.title: Validate PDF Digital Signature and Retrieve Certificate Details
validate-pdf-digital-signature__v2.description: Opens a PDF, enumerates signature fields, checks for a signature object, extracts the signing X.509 certificate and prints its properties.

sign-pdf-with-invisible-certification.title: Certify PDF with No-Modification Digital Signature
sign-pdf-with-invisible-certification.description: Demonstrates how to apply a certification‑level digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, making further modifications disallowed.

sign-pdf-certify-allow-form-filling.title: Sign and Certify PDF Allowing Form Filling Only
sign-pdf-certify-allow-form-filling.description: Loads a PDF, adds a visible signature field, signs it with a PKCS#12 certificate, and applies certification‑style restrictions that permit only form filling while blocking other content changes.

compute-verify-pdf-hash-before-after-sig.title: Compute and Verify PDF Hash Before and After Signing
compute-verify-pdf-hash-before-after-sig.description: Demonstrates how to calculate a SHA‑256 hash of a PDF, apply a digital signature with Aspose.Pdf, then recompute the hash to confirm that signing altered the file while preserving integrity.

pdf-with-encrypted-attachment-and-signat.title: Create PDF with Encrypted Attachment and Digital Signature
pdf-with-encrypted-attachment-and-signat.description: The example encrypts a file using AES‑256, embeds the encrypted data as an attachment in a PDF, adds a visible signature field, and digitally signs the document with a PKCS#7 certificate.

sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field__v2.title: Sign PDF and Lock Signature Field
sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field__v2.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, lock the signature field to prevent further edits, and save the signed document.

add-watermark-and-encrypt-pdf.title: Add Watermark and Encrypt PDF
add-watermark-and-encrypt-pdf.description: Demonstrates adding a centered semi‑transparent watermark to every page using TextStamp and then securing the PDF with user/owner passwords, specific permissions, and AES‑256 encryption.

validate-pdf-signature-ocsp.title: Validate PDF Signature Using OCSP
validate-pdf-signature-ocsp.description: Demonstrates how to locate a digital signature in a PDF and verify its integrity and revocation status using an OCSP responder with Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-digital-signature.title: Sign PDF with Digital Signature Using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-digital-signature.description: Loads a PDF, adds a signature field, signs it with a PKCS#7 certificate from a PFX file, and saves the signed document.

certified-pdf-signature-allow-add-pages.title: Sign PDF with Certification Allowing Additional Pages
certified-pdf-signature-allow-add-pages.description: The example opens an existing PDF, creates a signature field, signs it with a PKCS#7 certificate, and then adds a new blank page, demonstrating a certification level that permits adding pages after signing.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-unique-visible-sign.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Unique Visible Signature Images
batch-sign-pdfs-with-unique-visible-sign.description: The example loads multiple PDF files, adds a digital signature field on the last page, signs it with a PFX certificate, and overlays a unique visible signature image for each document.

list-signature-dictionaries-object-ids.title: List Signature Dictionaries and Their Object IDs
list-signature-dictionaries-object-ids.description: Shows how to enumerate signature fields in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and obtain each field's underlying PDF dictionary object ID using reflection.

download-sign-pdf-azure-blob.title: Download PDF, Add Placeholder Signature Field, and Save
download-sign-pdf-azure-blob.description: The example downloads a PDF from a URL, loads it with Aspose.Pdf, creates a signature field placeholder on the first page, and saves the modified document to a local folder representing Azure Blob storage.

create-readonly-secured-signed-pdf.title: Create Read‑Only Secured PDF and Add Digital Signature
create-readonly-secured-signed-pdf.description: The example builds a PDF in memory, applies AES‑256 encryption with read‑only permissions, adds a signature field, and digitally signs the document using a PKCS#7 certificate.
